ejā: [ ija + a + ā (itthī paccaññaḥ.) ijanaṃ ejā.] (thī) CL=7 [Nīti, sutta.1247. Lābhādiṃ paṭicca ejati kampatīti ejā, balava-taṇhā. Nīti,dhā.43.] The dhamma that causes to tremble. (taṇhā, kilesā‌, danger).
ejāhetu: [ ejā + hetu ] (pu) CL=7 A cause that is the danger of kilesā which causes to tremble.
ejānuga: [ ejā + anu + gamu + kvi.] (ti) CL=7 Always follow to taṇhā.
ejānugata: [ ejā + anugata ] (ti) CL=7 Always follow to taṇhā. Afflicted by taṇhā.
ejānusaṭa: [ ejā + anusaṭa ] (ti) CL=7 Covered with taṇhā. Goes along with taṇhā.
